result.question: What did the man of God do after speaking with the king?

readings.support: So the man of God went another way

readings.answer: He did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
readings.support: did not return by the way he had come to Bethel

assessments.reason: Verse 10 says, “So the man of God went another way,” which directly answers what he did after speaking with the king, though it omits the added detail that he did not return by the same route.
Verse 10 also states he “did not return by the way he had come to Bethel,” which describes his action after speaking with the king, though it omits the parallel phrasing that he went another way.
